rules.scope: restore a physically numeric field from a weak temporal-name role to quantitative when an explicit grouped min/max aggregation targets it, a distinct grouping dimension is grounded, and no temporal value summary or trend discourse exists
rules.rationale: Minimum and maximum can summarize numeric duration measures. A lexical time token is weaker than numeric value shape plus an explicit aggregate-target and grouping relation.
rules.failure_condition: Minimum wait_time by desk is encoded as a temporal axis and rejected despite numeric values and an explicit grouped aggregate.
rules.conflict_policy: Any parsed temporal value summary, datetime physical type, missing grouping dimension, absent explicit aggregate target, or trend discourse prevents restoration.

rules.scope: close ranking from an explicit rank/order target-link-score relation, one explicit score aggregation, typed dimension and measure roles, and an unambiguous order-direction phrase before generic grouped-superlative interpretation can dominate
rules.rationale: A ranking request is a relation among entity target, aggregate score, and ordering direction; closing those roles jointly prevents direction words from being mistaken for a second aggregate and removes entailed comparison/extremum peer labels.
rules.failure_condition: Order vendors by median cost from smallest to largest remains comparison, or ranking is emitted together with extremum.
rules.conflict_policy: Requires distinct strongly grounded target and score fields, an explicit aggregation targeting the score, a recognized linkage phrase, and exactly one direction; missing roles or non-ranking superlatives remain unchanged.
